opening.argument: The presentation promotes a front-running smart-contract bot as a way to produce “large amounts of profit within a short amount of time.” It directs viewers to obtain external contract code, connect MetaMask, deploy it, confirm wallet actions, and transfer Ether into the newly created contract. The funding instruction is concrete: viewers are told to start with 1 Ether, while the description recommends approximately 0.5 to 1 Ether. The workflow links that deposit and activation directly to automated buying, selling, and expected profit, followed by a claimed withdrawal after about 24 hours. Although a result of around 0.3 Ethereum is asserted, the contract’s behavior and the financial outcome are not independently verified.

citations.quote: the front run smart contract bot that I recently developed that can help you make large amounts of profit within a short amount of time
Metamask asks you to Confirm to connect your wallet to Remix. Click on the next and connect buttons in the Metamask pop-up window.
Let's go to the wallet and send some funds to contract that we just created. I'm going to start with 1 Ether.
After it's sent to the contract and pressing the action button, then the bot automatically starts buying and selling for you give it some time to generate profit.
I recommend funding the contract with around 1 - 0.5 ETH
